title: boechera repanda var. greenei
intro: Boechera repanda var. greenei, commonly known as Greene's rockcress, is a rare perennial plant species in the mustard family, characterized by its distinctive leaves and purple flowers. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to support respiratory health and alleviate symptoms associated with colds and flu, such as congestion and coughs. The therapeutic actions of Greene's rockcress include expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to ease respiratory discomfort and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of the plant include isothiocyanates, saponins, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
